benchmarks.title: Purchase value
benchmarks.question: Which published coin package includes the most immediate SC per dollar?
benchmarks.label: SC per $1
benchmarks.explanation: Ranked by immediate SC divided by the full package price, with no budget limit. Ordinary and first-purchase packages are labelled separately. This is a coin ratio, not a cash return.

benchmarks.title: Purchase bonuses at $10 or less
benchmarks.question: Which coin packages offer the most SC per dollar for $10 or less?
benchmarks.label: SC per $1
benchmarks.explanation: Complete packages costing $10 or less, ranked by immediate SC per dollar. More expensive packages cannot qualify through a prorated price.

benchmarks.title: Purchase bonuses at $20 or less
benchmarks.question: Which coin packages offer the most SC per dollar for $20 or less?
benchmarks.label: SC per $1
benchmarks.explanation: Complete packages costing $20 or less, ranked by immediate SC per dollar. The full purchase price and any first-purchase restriction are shown.

benchmarks.title: Daily free rewards
benchmarks.question: Which casinos publish the largest recurring daily free SC reward?
benchmarks.label: Daily free SC
benchmarks.explanation: Ranked by an explicitly recurring no-purchase daily SC allocation. A first-login reward or a staged welcome bonus is not counted as an every-day reward.

benchmarks.title: Cash redemption minimums
benchmarks.question: Which casinos publish the lowest cash redemption minimum?
benchmarks.label: Minimum SC
benchmarks.explanation: Ranked by published cash redemption minimum in SC, lowest first. Gift cards and thresholds without an explicit cash connection are separate. This does not rank payout speed.
